newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran takes delivery of last of five new oil tanker.
newsitem.headline: Iran takes delivery of last of five new oil tanker.

text.p: Iran has taken delivery of the last of five oil tankers it is buying from South Korea under a $490 million deal to replace its ageing fleet, the official news agency IRNA said on Wednesday.
It said the 300,000-tonne South Korean-built tanker joined the fleet of the National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC) this week taking up to 17 the number of NITC's operating tankers.
It said the new tanker was the last of the five Iran ordered from South Korea's Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd.
Iran is the world's third largest oil exporter. The five tankers would boost its tanker capacity to 3.6 million tonnes from 2.1 million tonnes.
